name: Computer use
summary: Let Claude open apps, look at the screen and click and type on your Mac.
what: Computer use lets Claude drive graphical apps from the terminal, for example to launch a native app it just built, click through it and take screenshots. You approve each app per session. It is a research preview.

impact.title: Test real apps
impact.detail: Claude can try native and Electron apps like a user would.

impact.title: Reach GUI-only tools
impact.detail: Work with tools that have no command line or API.

impact.title: Reproduce layout bugs
impact.detail: Resize windows and check the result.

howItWorks: Run /mcp and enable the built-in computer-use server for the project.
Grant macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording on first use.
Approve each app Claude asks to use.
Press Esc or Ctrl+C to stop.
macOS only in the terminal, on Pro, Max or Ultra plans.

events.note: First changelog mention of computer use on macOS.
